messages.subject: Error in R
parts:
Dear Group,

I ran a program in R with imbedded C, and got an error as follows: '1 SNPs with either high missing rates or no-variation are excluded'. The R program and C program do not have any variable named 'SNP'. The only variables that have some resemblance to 'SNP' are: snp.Sample, Nsnps, SNP1.OR, SNP2.OR (in the R program), and casesSnpCount, contrlsSnpCount, nSnps, NumSnps, snp1, snpid, nSnps1 (in the C program).

Please advise!

Thank You,

Benjamin

messages.author: 622854f56457d6cc
messages.subject: Re: [D-RUG]: Error in R
parts:
Hi Benjamin, 
Can you provide more details about the program you are running, and an example of your data? If you are calling genotypes from sequence data, an error message like that, where SNP refers to single nucleotide polymorphisms, makes sense: the program would not call a SNP if many of your samples are missing data at that locus, or if the locus is not polymorphic. 
Sincerely,
Caitlin
